3) DocuSign routing & authentication: recommended routing order and settings:  
   - Routing order: 1) procurement@novushealth.com (reviewer, set as "Needs to View") 2) Morgan Li (Signer) — require Email + SMS OTP; phone number: +1-415-555-0198 (confirm with Morgan) 3) Redwood countersigner (Karthik Iyer) 4) Final copy recipients: contracts@novushealth.com, laura@redwood.ai, sean@redwood.ai
   - Authentication: enable SMS OTP for Morgan; procurement can be email-only.
   - Signing certificate: include standard DocuSign audit trail.
   - Envelope expiration: 30 days. Reminders: 7 days and 3 days before expiration.

4) Attachments: please include the Authorizing Resolution in the envelope (PDF) and append the executed order form as a separate attachment.

5) Clean copy delivery: once countersigned, upload final signed PDF to the shared Drive folder and send a notification to contracts@novushealth.com. 

I will make the tiny residency language tweak and send a one-line confirmation when complete.

- Priya

Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
